sentences.en: The prosperity of the family dates from the Great War.
sentences.zh: 1. 这个家庭的繁荣始于第一次世界大战。

sentences.en: General prosperity and satisfaction are the best deterrents to revolution.
sentences.zh: 2. 普遍的繁荣和满足感是对革命最好的威慑。

sentences.en: Let’s drink to the prosperity of our common business!
sentences.zh: 3. 让我们为我们的共同事业干杯，祝它繁荣昌盛！

senses.zh: 幸运; 顺利 兴旺, 繁荣

mnemonic: 词根记忆：pro（在前）+sper（希望）+ ity→希望在前方→繁荣，成功
